title: The Recycler: In-Transit Machine Learning on High-Fidelity Data from Simulation Campaigns as an Optimized Approach for Building Frontier Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.31434v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We report on the first realization of in-transit machine learning using data streamed from multiple simulations running in parallel to the training on the same exascale high performance computing system. This workflow can be commonly applied to a broad variety of scenarios in which simulation campaigns play an important role. Unlike single simulations, campaigns run several simulations in parallel. This is interesting for finding an optimum operation point of a machine like a particle accelerator or a fusion reactor, quantifying the variation in model predictions e.g. in climate research, or discovering new capabilities e.g. in materials or drug design. Such campaigns produce huge amounts of high-fidelity data at high rates. File system bandwidth and capacity prohibit retaining all of that data, usually requiring orders of magnitude in reduction before it can be stored. translated_title: 回收器：基于仿真活动高保真数据的在途机器学习——一种构建前沿模型的优化方法
translated_abstract: 我们报告了首次实现在途机器学习，其使用从多个并行运行的仿真中流式传输的数据，在同一台百亿亿次（exascale）高性能计算系统上进行训练。该工作流程可广泛应用于仿真活动发挥重要作用的各类场景。与单一仿真不同，仿真活动会并行运行多个仿真。这对于寻找诸如粒子加速器或聚变反应堆等机器的最佳运行点、量化模型预测的变化（例如在气候研究中），或者发现新的能力（例如在材料或药物设计中）都具有重要意义。此类仿真活动会以极高的速率产生海量高保真数据。文件系统的带宽和容量限制使得无法保留全部数据，通常需要先将数据缩减数个数量级才能存储。我们展示了一种工作流程，可以将数据从多个仿真中流式传输……
tldr: 该论文首次实现了在同一台百亿亿次超算系统上，将多个并行仿真产生的高保真数据以流式传输方式直接用于在途机器学习训练，从而绕过文件系统带宽和容量的限制，优化前沿模型的构建。
en_tdlr: This paper reports the first realization of in-transit machine learning that streams high-fidelity data from multiple parallel simulations directly into training on the same exascale HPC system, circumventing file system bandwidth and capacity limitations as an optimized approach for building frontier models.
